newsitem.title: DUBAI: Arabsat says awards Aerospatiale satellite deal.
newsitem.headline: Arabsat says awards Aerospatiale satellite deal.

text.p: Arab Satellite Communication Organisation (Arabsat) said on Thursday it had awarded a deal worth at least $90 million to France's Aerospatiale for its third second-generation satellite. It may be launched in 1998 or early 1999.

"It was awarded to Aerospatiale yesterday. We have already informed them, but we still have to sign the contract after completing negotiations," Arabsat director general Saad al-Bidnah told Reuters, adding it was worth at least $90 million.
Bidnah said the satellite may be called Broadcasting Satellite System 1 or BSS1.
Arabsat, which operates satellite communications for Arab countries including television, telephone and data transmission, is jointly owned by 21 Arab states.
